coverage_policy: continuous visual coverage from 0.0 through locked VO end; adjacent shot windows share exact boundaries

units.narration_anchor: At 8:47 p.m ... permission to respond to a real problem
units.action: An unanswered after-hours ring leaves behind a permissioned red call tag without implying a guaranteed job

events.change: 8:47 PM appears as a physical time stamp; the phone rings once
One red tag pulls from the phone with CALL-R01 and 20:47
The ring stops; the tag remains while the work-order card stays visibly empty
The tag is framed as an opportunity, not revenue; a NO GUARANTEE stamp stays outside the tag
A permission tab attaches to the tag; no booking or money state changes

units.narration_anchor: By morning ... broken path between attention and action
units.action: The same call tag is buried in a crowded paper voicemail stack while the homeowner's path continues right and the relationship bridge opens below

events.change: Hard cut to morning paper stack; the root-level tag lands in the same screen direction
The tag slides behind three neutral voicemail sheets and becomes unprioritized
The homeowner continuation arrow exits frame right without blame
The physical gap below the tag opens and receives the label RELATIONSHIP
The bridge between ATTENTION and ACTION separates; the tag remains on the attention side

units.narration_anchor: A recovery system is simple ... send a useful acknowledgment
units.action: The source fixture is introduced at the proof bench, one call-time field is highlighted and extracted, and the recovered tag runs capture, classify, and acknowledgment in causal order

events.change: Cut to the navy rail; the red tag preserves x-direction and enters at the recovery intake
The CSV source context opens at the proof bench with the full synthetic warning
The tag locks into CAPTURE; no new customer identity is invented
Only call_time=20:47 is highlighted in the source
20:47 detaches from the highlighted field and attaches to the tag; the source remains pinned
The tag moves to CLASSIFY and receives UNCERTAIN; certainty is not faked
A short ACKNOWLEDGED state appears; no message interface or sales copy is fabricated

units.narration_anchor: place uncertain cases behind a human review gate ... next available slot
units.action: The uncertain tag is physically held under an operator hand; only a deliberate review releases it toward a neutral next-slot object

events.change: The UNCERTAIN tag reaches a physical barrier and stops
A conspicuous operator-hand placeholder turns the tag and checks the attached context
The gate changes from HOLD to RELEASE by human action, not by elapsed time
A neutral NEXT AVAILABLE SLOT tab extends; no calendar interface or availability claim

units.narration_anchor: If the customer declines, stop ... scheduled job the operator can measure
units.action: A single decision fork first lights the decline-to-stop route while the card stays empty, then the persistent tag takes the accepted route and stamps a scheduled work order

events.change: Cut to one decision fork; no object duplicates
The lower DECLINE rail lights to STOP; the call tag remains at the fork and the work-order card remains OFFERED
The decline rail settles as a suppressed terminal, clearly one possible branch
The same tag travels on the accepted rail; identity and screen direction remain intact
The tag clips to the work-order card; the card changes from OFFERED to SCHEDULED
A MEASURABLE registration mark appears without inventing a financial result

units.narration_anchor: The blueprint is not automate every response ... judgment where trust matters
units.action: A controlled pullback reveals only the causal recovery rail; a bypass rail labeled AUTOMATE ALL is physically removed while the human gate remains in the route

events.change: Cut on the measurable mark to a closer system fragment; no full-world overview
One measured pullback reveals capture, classify, acknowledge, gate, offer, stop/book
The operator hand removes a straight-through AUTOMATE ALL bypass rail
PRESERVE is registered at the call tag
ROUTE is registered along the causal rail
JUDGMENT stays physically anchored at the human gate; all motion settles for a readable hold

units.narration_anchor: The first test is one week ... call to reply to booked appointment
units.action: A one-week measurement bracket connects the original call tag to reply and booked appointment, while the synthetic source remains pinned and no performance number is invented

events.change: Cut to the proof bench; source pin remains in the same right-edge location
Seven unlabeled day ticks draw as a bounded one-week bracket; no result number
The work-order card changes from SCHEDULED to MEASURED as the bracket begins connecting the persistent objects
CALL, REPLY, and BOOKED APPT complete the bracket; the measured card and exact synthetic warning hold through the final word
